definition.gain: received power over focusing at the same position, known position and geometry
definition.shadow_loss: received power over the unobstructed focused link at the same position (dB)
definition.se_los10: log2(1 + SNR) with the unobstructed focused link at 10 dB SNR
definition.room_absolute: noise fixed by the 0.2 m reference link at x = 0.095 m (SNR 10 dB there); 'total' keeps total transmit power, 'per_element' scales it with element count
definition.deep: geometric blockage ratio >= 0.8 for that aperture; deep_ref uses the 0.2 m aperture
